bibl.title: "Barbarians" and Blemmyes: Who Was in Control of the Red Sea Port of Berenike in the Late Antique Period?
bibl.seg: Matthew Cobb, "Barbarians" and Blemmyes: Who Was in Control of the Red Sea Port of Berenike in the Late Antique Period?
bibl.note: Context: Red Sea activity from the imperial to the late antique period. - Problems with the source material. - Scenario one: Christianized Saracen foederati. - Scenarios two and three: the Blemmyes and Berenike. - Conclusion.
